title: ThermoLLM: LLM-Based Multi-Zone HVAC Control with a Spatiotemporal Context
abstract: arXiv:2606.22911v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-zone HVAC control is a spatial decision problem in which indoor thermal evolution and control decisions depend not only on outdoor conditions and internal heat gains but also on zone layout, physical adjacency, and delayed thermal interactions across the building. Recent LLM-based HVAC controllers have shown that prompt-based control is feasible. However, these methods produce inconsistent results, are difficult to generalize, and experience control-latency issues. Their performance also relies heavily on numeric reward values, textual feedback, or unstructured retrieval, which limits their ability to make control decisions that account for zone dynamics and thermodynamics. No existing LLM-based methods have used building semantics and dynamics, together with rolling history, as the centre of the LLM context while testing and comparing HVAC control performance with existing LLM-based HVAC approaches. This paper presents ThermoL

translated_title: ThermoLLM：基于时空上下文的LLM多区域暖通空调（HVAC）控制
translated_abstract: 多区域HVAC控制是一个空间决策问题，室内热演化与控制决策不仅取决于室外条件和内部得热，还取决于区域布局、物理相邻关系以及整个建筑内跨区域的延迟热交互。近年来基于大语言模型（LLM）的HVAC控制器已经表明基于提示词的控制是可行的，然而这些方法产生不一致的结果、难以泛化，并存在控制延迟问题。其性能还严重依赖于数值奖励值、文本反馈或非结构化检索，这限制了它们做出能够兼顾区域动力学与热力学的控制决策的能力。目前尚无基于LLM的方法在将建筑语义与动力学连同滚动历史作为LLM上下文核心的同时，与现有基于LLM的HVAC方法进行控制性能的测试与比较。本文提出了ThermoL……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出ThermoLLM，将建筑空间语义、区域热动力学与滚动历史作为LLM上下文的核心，从而实现更一致、更可泛化且能感知区域间延迟热交互的多区域HVAC控制。
en_tdlr: ThermoLLM centers the LLM context on building semantics, zone thermal dynamics, and rolling history, enabling consistent and generalizable multi-zone HVAC control that accounts for spatial layout and delayed thermal interactions.
